name: Discounts as built
description:
This design reads the discounts code as it was built before the weather-based discount, every element added to an empty model: the [discounts](noesis:module|discounts) a shop grants on an offer, depending on the customer's status. It is the starting point the "Weather-based discount" change builds on.

# Where it lands

- [calculation](noesis:module|discounts.calculation) holds the discounts and the calculation that applies them.
- [offers](noesis:module|discounts.offers) and [users](noesis:module|discounts.users) hold what the calculation receives: the offer and the customer.

# Where to start reading

1. [DiscountCalculation.calculate](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountCalculation.calculate), the one application service: it takes an [Offer](noesis:building_block|discounts.offers.Offer) and a [UserId](noesis:building_block|discounts.users.UserId) and gives a [DiscountedOffer](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountedOffer).
2. [DiscountPolicyFactory.get](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountPolicyFactory.get) puts the customer's [UserStatus](noesis:building_block|discounts.users.UserStatus) into [Conditions](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.Conditions) and returns the discounts that apply under them.
3. [DiscountConfig](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountConfig) lists the shop's [PotentialDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.PotentialDiscount)s; each tells whether it [applies](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialDiscount.isApplicableFor) and which [discount](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialDiscount.getDiscount) it grants.
4. [Discount.apply](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.Discount.apply) adds one discount to the offer as discounted so far; the calculation applies them one after another.

# Around them

- The one potential discount so far: [PotentialVipUserDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.PotentialVipUserDiscount) for VIP customers.
- The discounts themselves: [FixedDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.FixedDiscount), [ExclusiveOfferLevelDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.ExclusiveOfferLevelDiscount) and the per-product [ProductDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.ProductDiscount). Each granted one is a [DiscountAmount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountAmount), on the offer or on a [DiscountedProduct](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountedProduct).
- The sources: [DiscountsConfigProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountsConfigProvider) gives the configuration and [UserStatusProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.users.UserStatusProvider) the status.

# Not in this design

- No rules or scenarios: the Java scanner reads none from the code, and the design carries only what the scan returns.
- Types without a stereotype annotation, such as the application's `App` entry point, and everything under `src/test`.
